description: Implementation of Vehicle Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) interface, including property management, callbacks, and timer handling for vehicle properties.

classes.name: VehicleHalImpl
classes.description: Class implementing vehicle property management, including property registration, callbacks, and periodic updates.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::VehicleHalImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing property store, vehicle client, and timer.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::onCreate
methods.description: Initializes properties in the property store.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specified vehicle property.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to continuous updates for a property at a specified sample rate.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from continuous updates for a property.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::onPropertyValue
methods.description: Handles property value updates and triggers HAL events.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::regPropsInPropStore
methods.description: Registers predefined properties in the property store.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::initPropsInPropStore
methods.description: Initializes properties with default or stored values.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::onContinuousPropertyTimer
methods.description: Handles periodic timer events for continuous properties.

methods.name: VehicleHalImpl::isContinuousProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property is of continuous change mode.
